question: Which act has been amended by the Supreme Court of India to provide equal rights to daughters in their ancestral property?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Hindu Succession Act.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hindu Succession Act:-**

 
 
• It​ was amended in **2005** to provide **equal rights to daughters** in their ancestral property.
 
• Prior to this amendment, only sons had the **right to inherit ancestral property.**
 
• The amendment applies to **ancestral property** as well as **self-acquired property.**
 
• The amendment is a **significant step towards** gender **equality and empowerment **of women in India. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Informatio__**

 
• **Hindu Marriage Act:**

 
 
• It​** **deals with marriage and divorce laws for Hindus.
 
 
 
• **Sarda Act:-**
 
 
• It is​** **also known as the **Child Marriage Restraint Act.**
 
• It was enacted in **1929** to prevent child marriages.
 
 
 
• **Contempt of Courts Act:-**
 
 
• It is a law in India that defines and punishes contempt of court. Contempt of court is any act that undermines the authority, dignity, or integrity of a court of law.
 
• It can be committed by anyone, including individuals, lawyers, judges, and even the media.
 
• It was enacted in 1971.
